verdict.line: You lose if you walk into her Q (Precision Protocol) empowered auto while standing still; you win if you hook her with Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) before she reaches a wall for E (Hookshot).

brief.thesis: Camille's entire engage is wall-dependent: E (Hookshot) only knocks up if she leaps off terrain, and without it her only pressure tool is the Q (Precision Protocol) empowered auto at 325 range. Kled's Q hooks and yanks from 800 range, letting him start every fight on his terms, and because Skaarl's health bar absorbs the trade, Kled can afford to fight through her pokes to refill courage. That structural gap is why Kled sits at 58.6% over 99 games here with both lane and solo-kill advantage.

tell.watch: Camille's E (Hookshot) cooldown and wall proximity

theirWindow.when: she's near a wall with E up
theirWindow.what: She can leap off terrain with E (Hookshot) for a knock-up, then follow with an empowered Q (Precision Protocol) auto and W (Tactical Sweep) for extra damage and healing. Back off the wall or bait the leap early so it lands on nothing.

yourWindow.when: her E is down or no wall nearby
yourWindow.what: She has no gap-closer or escape besides Q's move speed. Throw Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) at 800 range to hook and yank her in, then pop W (Violent Tendencies) for the attack-speed window before she can walk into her own 325-range auto trade.

start.why: The most-picked start (81.6% pick, 51.6% WR) gives sustain and damage to trade through her Q pokes while you look to land hooks.

boots.why: Run on 83.8% of games with a 59% WR; flat reduction blunts her auto-attack and Q-empowered-auto poke.

core.why: First item on the top-performing path (71.4% WR); the health and bonus damage let Skaarl tank her burst while you trade back.
Second on that same path; the shred compounds with your repeated E (Jousting) dash-ins to keep trades in your favor.
Closes out the 71.4%-WR core path with extra health and damage for extended skirmishes once courage is being refilled on cooldown.

situational.when: she's building burst and you need to survive her all-in
you're ahead and want to siege or split-push off your lead

runes.keystoneWhy: Extended skirmishes with Skaarl absorbing damage mean you want the sustain-through-stacks payoff Conqueror gives in prolonged trades, not a single burst window.

summoners.why: The most-picked combo (81% pick, 55.3% WR); Ignite converts your lane's solo-kill advantage into actual kills before she can disengage with Q's move speed.

playing.title: Hook her off walls
playing.detail: Throw Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) the moment she drifts near terrain to yank her away before she can set up E (Hookshot), since her engage requires leaping off a wall.

playing.title: Joust through her dive
playing.detail: Use E (Jousting)'s dash to reposition the instant you see her wind up toward a wall, matching the read that Jousting is your tool to dodge her Hookshot.

playing.title: Pop W before trading
playing.detail: Activate W (Violent Tendencies) right as you land a Q hook so the attack-speed window and empowered fourth hit land while she's still closing to her own 325-range auto.

playing.title: Fight to refill courage
playing.detail: Stay in short trades instead of disengaging; fighting refills Skaarl's courage bar, and remounting restores health and your full damage kit.

playing.title: Respect her delayed Q
playing.detail: If she holds her Q (Precision Protocol) empowered auto instead of using it immediately, back off briefly since the recast deals significantly more damage the longer she waits.

playing.title: Punish her E cooldown
playing.detail: Hookshot sits on a 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown; the moment she uses it to engage or reposition, that window is free to zone or hook her with no retaliation threat.

playing.title: Use R to snowball out
playing.detail: Once R (Chaaaaaaaarge!!!) is up at level 6, its 3500 range lets you convert your lane lead into other lanes rather than staying locked in a won matchup.

brief.patchCaveat: All build paths, runes, boots, summoner spells, and win-rate/sample numbers above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning tying them together is my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Try to dodge Camille’s Wall Dive (E) with Jousting [E]. Avoid being punished by her basic attacks and try to contest lane by using Bear Trap on a Rope [Q] or Jousting [E].
